description.message: Send a page, video or link to Miarina Media on this computer.

popupLead.message: Send this page to Miarina Media: the analysis opens in the app, you choose the format.

popupNote.message: Nothing is read from pages: only the link you send leaves, and only to Miarina Media.

sent.message: Sent: the analysis opens in Miarina Media.

notWeb.message: Only web pages (http, https) can be sent.

notConnected.message: Not connected yet: in Miarina Media, Settings › Browser extension, turn on “Accept links sent by the extension”.

failed.message: Miarina Media could not open this link.
